newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Reliance allowed to compound share cases.
newsitem.headline: India's Reliance allowed to compound share cases.

text.p: India's Company Law Board on Monday allowed top private firm Reliance Industries to compound 29 complaints filed by the Registrar of Companies (ROC), a court official said.
The Company Law Board ordered that the compounding would be subject to the necessary court permission -- which Reliance is expected to seek on Tuesday -- and payment of 2.42 million rupees.
The ROC had filed 29 complaints in July against Reliance Industries and others for offenses relating to the issue of duplicate share certificates and share switching.
